channel.title: Burundi - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Burundi, every source cited.

item.title: Burundi U15 team loses to Canada in FIFA tournament
item.description: The Burundi U15 team was eliminated from the FIFA U15 World Cup Festival after a 7-0 loss to Canada in Division D quarter-finals.

item.title: Burundi farmers face fertilizer shortages
item.description: Farmers in Gitega report insufficient fertilizer distribution and delays in refunds, threatening harvests.
